steps.what: Collect cash or card payments, make change and provide customers with receipts

tasks.design: Keep attendant payment handling in the existing {OTHER} point-of-sale system. Existing card processing, change calculation and receipt generation earn no new labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Payment handling still requires customer interaction and exception handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native till functions already support the transaction.
tasks.still_hard: Disputed amounts, declined cards and cash discrepancies.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve payment questions and handle cash accurately.

evidence.claim: The design assumes an existing point-of-sale system and claims no new saving from its payment runtime.

assumptions: Boundary is attendant transaction handling, excluding customer payment entry and bank processing.
Attendant records item or pump transaction, quantity and payment choice during this fully retained step. Customer supplies payment; no new capture is transferred.
Use existing till functions; no change or incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which payment exceptions consume attendant time?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; existing transaction processing is not a new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check stock and order required goods
Price incoming goods and check shelf labels
Shelve incoming goods in the correct locations

tasks.design: Configure native {PROCUREMENT} reorder suggestions and {OTHER} point-of-sale label printing. Keep physical stock checks, order acceptance, received-item matching and shelving with the attendant.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated catalogue entry and price-label transcription can remain manual.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing stock and till functions can reuse approved item identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Recorded quantities may disagree with shelves and actual deliveries.
tasks.human_edge: Check physical stock and reject unsuitable substitutions.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated entry, with stock checks and shelving unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native reorder suggestions and label printing can reduce repeated entry; the digest supplies no measured attendant result.

assumptions: Boundary is attendant ordering, pricing and shelving, excluding supplier picking and delivery.

Attendant produces checked stock quantity, item id, order quantity and required date in s1's 21 retained hours; physical checking and missing values are retained. Manager supplies approved minimum levels, pack sizes and selling prices through existing catalogue maintenance; extra mapping upkeep is counted below.
Attendant matches delivered item ids and prices during s2's10 retained hours. Missing prices or substitutions require manual approval before labels are used.
Test native stock, saved-order and till-label functions first; no saving comes from existing runtime.
research_questions: Do ordering and label preparation remain faster after physical checks and exceptions?

already_counted.description: Physical stock checks, missing input capture and order acceptance
Match received goods and verify prices

incremental.description: Resolve catalogue exceptions and review saved requests
Maintain item mappings and approved reorder settings

approvals.approved_version: Exact supplier, item identifiers, quantities, prices and delivery date of order; edits require fresh acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R76 gross24 less3 upkeep =21 net E1. High needs repeated catalogue and label entry; low covers inaccurate stock or already configured native functions.

steps.what: Sell suitable accessories after checking vehicle fit and customer needs
Install accessories and check their operation

tasks.design: Retain accessory suitability checks, sale discussion and physical installation. Existing fit information in {DOCS} supports the attendant without replacing the work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Physical fit and installation vary by vehicle and accessory.
tasks.still_hard: Identifying incorrect parts and installation risks.
tasks.human_edge: Check the actual vehicle and verify safe operation.

evidence.claim: Suitability discussion and physical installation remain fully counted.

assumptions: Boundary is accessory selection and installation; payment collection belongs to the separate payment task and is not added here.
Attendant observes vehicle details and checks specifications during s1; no pre-existing structured fit code is assumed.
No software change or additional upkeep.
unknowns: Accessory range and permitted service scope
research_questions: Which installations should be referred to a technician?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; physical installation and fit checks remain.

tasks.short: Prepare daily fuel and accessory sales reports

steps.what: Reconcile source sales and identify missing or corrected transactions
Prepare daily reports of fuel, oil and accessory sales
Check daily totals and submit the report to the supervisor

tasks.design: Configure the {OTHER} point-of-sale system's native daily sales report to replace spreadsheet compilation. Keep source reconciliation and final report checking; use a custom export only if native reporting cannot meet the agreed fields.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sales totals may be recopied into a daily spreadsheet.
tasks.enabler_now: Recorded transactions can be grouped deterministically by period and sales category.
tasks.still_hard: Missing sales, voids and incorrect category mappings.
tasks.human_edge: Explain discrepancies rather than accepting plausible totals.
tasks.altitude: Less report assembly, with reconciliation responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Sales reports can be compiled deterministically from till records; this is a design inference, without a measured case in the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is daily reporting, excluding sale capture already counted in the payment task.

Attendant produces transaction id, date, item or fuel category, quantity, price, tax and void status during existing checkout work with unchanged capture time; pump system records volume. No additional transaction capture is assumed.

Attendant produces checked cutoff, station id, corrections and category exceptions during s1 at full30 hours. Missing transactions and unmapped items require manual reconciliation before s2; final verification remains25 hours.
Test native till reporting first. Only manual spreadsheet assembly earns savings; existing transaction runtime does not.
unknowns: Report fields and till export completeness
research_questions: Can native reports reproduce reconciled daily totals after voids and cutoff changes?

already_counted.description: Source reconciliation and report parameter capture

incremental.description: Maintain categories and investigate report changes
Maintain report access and export mapping

approvals.approved_version: Exact station, cutoff, transaction snapshot and report totals; corrections void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R55 gross45 less4 upkeep =41 net E1. High requires manual spreadsheet assembly today; low covers an existing native report or frequent missing transactions.
